card.name: Linking words before nasal polyps and similar terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words or word starts (and, with, by, other, the) just before a medical condition term, most often nasal polyps, rhinosinusitis, or vasculitis types. The next word is a specific condition or anatomy term.
